# CLI Reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->
This file is generated from `repo_graph.cli.build_parser`.

## Root Usage

```text
repo-graph [-h]
                  {inspect,sync,build,refresh,serve,load,stats,agent-instructions,report,snapshot,source-graphs} ...
```

## Command Tree

| Command | Help |
| --- | --- |
| `repo-graph inspect` | Validate and summarize a source config. |
| `repo-graph sync` | Clone or update Git sources into the local cache. |
| `repo-graph build` | Build a portable graph JSON file. |
| `repo-graph refresh` | Build from source artifacts and optionally load changed sources into Neo4j. |
| `repo-graph serve` | Run the local Repo Graph HTTP API. |
| `repo-graph load` | Load a graph JSON export into Neo4j. |
| `repo-graph stats` | Read Repo Graph counts from Neo4j. |
| `repo-graph agent-instructions` | Print a Markdown Repo Graph agent snippet. |
| `repo-graph report` | Generate reports from a graph JSON export. |
| `repo-graph report unresolved` | Group unresolved graph edges. |
| `repo-graph snapshot` | Inspect or write source snapshots. |
| `repo-graph snapshot status` | Compare current sources to snapshots. |
| `repo-graph snapshot write` | Write current source snapshots. |
| `repo-graph source-graphs` | Build source-level graph artifacts. |
| `repo-graph source-graphs write` | Write one graph artifact per source. |

## `repo-graph build`

Build a portable graph JSON file.

```text
repo-graph build [-h] --config CONFIG [--output OUTPUT] [--sync] [--strict] [--cached]
                        [--max-file-bytes MAX_FILE_BYTES]
```

| Option | Required | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | yes |  |  |
| `--output` | no |  |  |
| `--sync` | no | `false` | Sync Git sources before scanning. |
| `--strict` | no | `false` | Fail if any configured source cannot be scanned. |
| `--cached` | no | `false` | Reuse unchanged source graph artifacts. |
| `--max-file-bytes` | no | `1000000` |  |

## `repo-graph refresh`

Build from source artifacts and optionally load changed sources into Neo4j.

```text
repo-graph refresh [-h] --config CONFIG [--output OUTPUT] [--sync] [--strict] [--load]
                          [--max-file-bytes MAX_FILE_BYTES]
```

| Option | Required | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | yes |  |  |
| `--output` | no |  |  |
| `--sync` | no | `false` | Sync Git sources before scanning. |
| `--strict` | no | `false` | Fail if any configured source cannot be scanned. |
| `--load` | no | `false` | Load the refreshed graph into Neo4j. |
| `--max-file-bytes` | no | `1000000` |  |

## `repo-graph load`

Load a graph JSON export into Neo4j.

```text
repo-graph load [-h] --graph GRAPH [--append] [--replace-source REPLACE_SOURCE]
```

| Option | Required | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--graph` | yes |  |  |
| `--append` | no | `false` | Keep existing Repo Graph data in Neo4j. |
| `--replace-source` | no |  | Replace one source's Neo4j data from a globally resolved graph. Repeat for multiple sources. |
